mapper.sql: (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM db_database d WHERE d.system_id = s.id AND d.status = 1) AS database_count, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM db_table_doc t WHERE t.system_id = s.id AND t.status = 1) AS table_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO db_system (system_name, system_code, vendor, db_type, version, owner_name, remark, status, sort_no, created_by) VALUES (#{systemName}, #{systemCode}, #{vendor}, #{dbType}, #{version}, #{ownerName}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{sortNo}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE db_system SET system_name = #{systemName}, system_code = #{systemCode}, vendor = #{vendor}, db_type = #{dbType}, version = #{version}, owner_name = #{ownerName}, remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, sort_no = #{sortNo} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, FROM db_system s WHERE s.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
